title: Daily readings of a reference mass
intro: A load cell weighed the same 100 kg reference mass once a day for 20 days, to estimate how fast its reading drifts (creep). The line of reading against day fits well, but the residuals come in long runs: three days high, ten days low, then six of the last seven high. Durbin–Watson = 0.77 says the errors of successive days are related, so the independence assumption fails. The normal Q–Q plot and Shapiro–Wilk show no problem with normality.
